_comment: US-038: the card pipeline's own story rubric, read by scripts/judge-stories.js (Jev). Seeded from .claude/agents/_nemo.md's judgment gates and score table at build time; _nemo.md is never read at run time. Every question is worded so that yes = pass. A gate passes only when its summary and every split-out question pass (p >= 0.5). Axis levels are indexed 0-2; an axis score is the level + 1.

vividness.summary: Could this sentence be drawn as one concrete scene, a specific moment rather than a generic, flat image or a restatement of the definition in other words?

questions.specific-moment: Does the sentence show one specific moment, not a generic situation?
questions.beyond-definition: Is the sentence more than a restatement of the word's definition?
questions.single-picture: Could the sentence be drawn as a single picture?

scene-coherence.summary: Could every location and object in this sentence physically be in the same place at the same time? (An attic, indoors under a roof, and a creek, outdoors, can't be the same scene.)

questions.one-setting: Does the whole sentence happen in one setting, not two places stitched together?
questions.objects-together: Is every object in the sentence physically there at the same time?

animal-harm.summary: Is the scene free of any animal being harmed, eaten, hunted or otherwise mistreated? (Animal imagery itself is fine: an octopus or a fox can appear in a scene.)

questions.not-hurt: Is no animal hurt or injured in the scene?
questions.not-eaten: Is no animal eaten, cooked or hunted in the scene?
questions.not-mistreated: Is no animal mistreated or made to suffer in the scene?

anchor.label: Anchor fidelity
levels: the sound anchor is a loose or partial sound match for its IPA chunk
the sound anchor matches most of its IPA chunk
the sound anchor matches its IPA chunk exactly

meaning.label: Meaning-carry
levels: the meaning is bolted on beside the anchor
the meaning is present but a bit of a stretch
the anchor's own image literally depicts the sense word

vivid.label: Vividness
levels: generic or flat, close to restating the definition
